english: What is it that this reality veils? Given the wording “deceived about what is actually there,” what we're referring to is deception—a veil—in the sense of what covers & conceals actual reality. This is not meant to be a reference to a “correct” form of deceptive reality, in the division of that reality into correct & mistaken.
